questions.prompt: Describe the locus of points 4 cm from fixed point O.
questions.correct_answer: Circle centred at O, radius 4 cm.

questions.prompt: Describe the locus equidistant from two fixed points A and B.
A point must be equidistant from two intersecting roads. Which locus is needed?
Describe the region less than 3 cm from a fixed point.
questions.correct_answer: Interior of a circle of radius 3 cm, excluding boundary.

questions.prompt: How can two intersecting loci identify a point?
questions.correct_answer: The point must satisfy both conditions.
